reason: Real error: the reprint says carriers are "connected via API or electronic data interchange [EDI]" and exchange rates, booking requests, confirmations and tracking events, in the core product or through partnerships (Gartner MQ TMS 2026 reprint, re-read this run). Fix quotes it correctly.

"bid and rate management and optimization" is in the freight sourcing bullet; no standalone "rating" or "tender" in the reprint; the carrier-integration feature exchanges booking requests and confirmations (Gartner MQ TMS 2026 reprint, re-read this run). Fix is accurate and points to section 5, where f1 puts that feature.

Staudt et al. define a control tower as integrating "real-time data, advanced analytics, and organizational knowledge to provide end-to-end visibility, automate decision-making..." (SciELO full text, re-read). Fix quotes it correctly.
Filed SCE7 section 6 step 7 says "that it is a UN/EDIFACT message is unverified here"; the SCE8 pointer stated it as fact. Fix matches SCE7.

Problem is real (D2 bare blanks have no rule; D3 has one), but the fix names "the fourth column", which in D2 (#, Need, Shipper, Provider, ...) is Provider, not "Where the needs pull apart". Repaired as X1.
Must agree with f2; the reprint names "bid and rate management" under sourcing and has no word "tender". Accurate.
"payment" appears in two vendor profiles, Manhattan Associates ("Freight Payment Agent") and Pando ("freight audit and payment") (Gartner MQ TMS 2026 reprint, re-read this run).

The common analytics feature ("Analytic capabilities to make better transportation decisions") uses embedded analysis and reporting to measure KPIs such as on-time performance, emissions and costs by mode, customer, product line and location (Gartner MQ TMS 2026 reprint, re-read this run); "beyond the embedded kind" is wrong.
Reprint: "Aptean was dropped from this Magic Quadrant, as it did not meet the TMS technology customer criteria" (Gartner MQ TMS 2026 reprint, re-read this run).

Manuscript: 38% across the sample; the reasons (customers did not demand it; existing ICT systems would not support it) come from the case companies without the service, "most" of them (Aston manuscript, re-read).

Right to restore the aim, but "the same study found it unmet in its cases" goes beyond the paper, which reports that end-to-end supply chain management was not identified in the cases and two of three lacked real-time tracking or visibility layers; it does not state that end-to-end visibility was found unmet. Repaired as X2 using the paper's own finding.
First body use of Ostrel Foods in section 3.1 carries no label; Sofia is a person of the same case. Fix moves the label correctly.
Front-matter intro names Ostrel and Tandric without the fictional label while Halvern has it. Fix is right.
Case register in filed units (SCE1 section 2, SCE3 register note, SCE7 sections 1 and 8) gives 40 vehicles, not 40 drivers. Fix is right.
ETA is used once, in section 2, undefined. Fix spells it out; adds no claim.
Filed SCE6: deliverable C is the template; the steps are section 9's method, as SCE8 section 9 itself says. Fix is right.
